statement: Quest landing discovers and authorizes every exact in-scope path when whole-worktree status or staged and working candidate diffs exceed Node child-process defaults, using the landing and authorization owners' shared bounded Git buffer without weakening scope exclusion, content identity, expiry, atomic one-shot consumption, or fail-closed overflow.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
